oerkki.reviewed_by: Codex: direct final native/comparison/world/icon inspection; not user sign-off
oerkki.notes: Own authored mesh/UV/pixels/rig/clips. Restores distinct dark long-armed Oerkki with jaw/claws, green tall Orc with leather and bulky shoulders, pale broad-bellied short-legged Ogre with long club. Baseline nearly-black Oerkki reproduced in native Release; new own charcoal planes intentionally readable. Original idle/walk/run/punch retained; die not present in original. Shoulder masses enlarged after first comparison; rigid chest-bound armor replaces visibly rubber-bent blended plates. Orc upper arm tapered to matching elbow cross-section. Full skinning tests check joint closure, proximal attachment, stance direction, calibrated stride speed, loop, swing, floor and true weapon/claw actions. Runtime gameplay bounds/speeds/habitat preserved. Walk/Run contact keys increased to 129 after inter-key audit; final 257-phase full-skinning bounds -0.000134 to +0.000968 blocks, including phases between the new keys. Prior 129-phase diagnostic is retained; thresholds were not weakened. Exact revised native/world captures reinspected before this review. Full routes/transitions/travelScale limits/compatibility/performance remain R6; no performance PASS.
